press.title: 25 లక్షల మంది భక్తులు.. రూ.25 కోట్లతో ఏర్పాట్లు
press.summary: The Durga temple trust board, meeting under chairman Borra Radhakrishna (Gandhi) with Executive Officer V.K. Seena Naik, approved ₹25 crore of arrangements for this year’s Sharannavaratri festival, expecting about 25 lakh devotees. The photograph shows the board in session.
